summary: This Form 6-K reports a director/PDMR shareholding transaction by RELX PLC, a foreign private issuer. On June 17, 2026, a PDMR was granted options over 922 ordinary shares under the RELX PLC ShareSave Plan 2023 at an exercise price of 19.728, with nil cost to the recipient. The filing is a routine disclosure of equity incentive grants to insiders under Rule 13a-16. No tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return is involved. The report is neutral and administrative in nature, reflecting standard insider compensation disclosure requirements under UK regulations, mapped to US Form 8-K Item 5.02. What to watch: typical for insider grants with no market-moving implications.
